THE CRUCIBLE POUR: a bright thread of molten gold falling from a tipped crucible into the mould bed, the light climbing the walls as it falls, everything nearest edged in warm gold
GOLD THREAD FALLING: the thinnest thread of liquid metal leaving the lip of the crucible, the light spilling outward as it drops, whatever stands nearest catching the glare along its top edges
POUR INTO THE BED: molten gold tipping free and falling in a glowing arc, the light washing up the nearest surfaces as it lands, deep amber pooling across everything low
THE SLOW POUR: a crucible tilting and a patient thread of molten brightness falling into the mould bed, the light climbing as it falls and everything overhead edged in flickering copper

CRUCIBLE TIPPED WIDE: a generous pour of molten gold falling bright and steady, the light spilling generously outward, the stone beneath it washed rose and the surfaces nearest it all touched with living amber
SPARK FOUNTAIN OFF THE ANVIL: a fountain of orange sparks leaping high and drifting slowly upward into the dark, the nearest edges picked out and flickering one by one as each spark rises
SPARKS ACROSS THE FLOOR: a scatter of bright sparks skittering outward across the floor after a hammer strike, each one glowing its own small warm circle before winking sweetly out
SLOW SHOWER OF SPARKS: a gentle cascade of sparks falling past the near edge in a soft slow fall, each one tracing a short bright line before it settles and fades
SPARKS CLIMBING: a burst of sparks leaping upward from the struck metal, climbing in a loose bright drift and spreading as they rise, the surfaces nearest them briefly edged in dancing orange
DRIFTING SPARKS: a long loose drift of cooling sparks floating sideways across the open air, the light they carry washing softly across whatever they pass nearest and going out in quiet amber winks

THE QUENCH BURST: a blade going down into the trough and a soft white burst of steam blooming up around it, the water glowing from within for a warm shimmering moment, the whole near air gone luminous and pale

STEAM BLOOM: the quench water receiving a hot workpiece and the steam blooming up full and white, the light inside it spilling outward in every direction, everything nearest briefly washed in soft silver-gold
WATER AGLOW: a piece going under and the trough glowing from within as the steam rises, pale light pouring upward through the steam, the surfaces above it touched with a warm and wandering brightness
THE GENTLE QUENCH: a glowing piece lowered slowly and the steam curling up in a soft white plume, the near air gone hazy and bright, everything standing close edged in gentle luminous white
QUENCH GLOW: the trough lit briefly from beneath as the metal enters, steam rising in a full sweet cloud, the whole near air pale and warm and glowing as if the water itself had learned to shine

FURNACE DOOR SWUNG WIDE: the fire door opened and orange light washing out low across the floor in a broad generous wave, everything nearest flushed amber to waist height, the air above still cool and dim
THE DOOR OPENS: the furnace mouth swinging open and warm light rolling out low and easy, the far surfaces suddenly glowing from the waist down, everything higher still resting in soft shadow
FURNACE MOUTH OPEN: the fire door pulled wide and a broad wash of orange light spilling out across the floor, whatever stands nearest lit warm and rich on the side facing in, deep and cosy behind

ORANGE LIGHT ROLLING OUT: the furnace door swung back and the warm light pouring out low and full, the nearest surfaces glowing amber on their faces, the upper reaches fading into a friendly dimness above

THE FAR WALL WARMS: the fire door opened and light washing across the floor and climbing the far surface to waist height, the stone there glowing a rich baked orange, everything above still softly dark

WHITE-HOT BAR ON THE ANVIL: a bar drawn out white-hot and laid across the work surface, its own light pooling down onto the stone beneath it in a spreading warm oval, fading gently as it reaches the edges of the room
GLOWING WORKPIECE RESTING: a freshly worked piece lying bright across the anvil, the light it carries spilling downward and outward, the surfaces closest to it washed in shifting amber and gold
THE BAR COOLING: a white-hot bar resting and glowing, the light it pours onto the stone beneath it still generous and warm, the brightness fading at the edges into a soft and welcoming orange dusk

MOLTEN FLOW IN THE CHANNEL: bright molten rock creeping slowly along a carved channel, the light rising from it and washing everything above from below, the highest surfaces still cool and richly shadowed above the warm brightness beneath

BRIGHT CHANNEL FLOWING: a slow river of molten brightness moving along its channel, the light it carries spilling upward and catching the undersides of everything near, all the surfaces above glowing softly from beneath while the tops remain deep and serene
